info.description: One selectable value inside a variation group, e.g. "30 ml" or "Hyaluronic Acid 2%". `discountPercent` is the discount this particular value carries and is what the price is recalculated from; it replaces the product's own discount rather than stacking on top of it, so the badge on the chip and the badge in the price row always show the same number. `discountLabel` is only the text drawn on the chip — leave it empty and it is derived from the percent, fill it in to write something the percent cannot say. `icon` is the small square thumbnail the design draws to the left of the label on full-width chips; leave it empty and the chip is text only.
